gloss: to make excuses; to wriggle out of

definitions.gloss: to make excuses; to talk one's way out of
definitions.explanation: to avoid responsibility or blame by making excuses or evasive explanations

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}から{言|い}い{逃|のが}れる。
examples.english: To make excuses to avoid responsibility.

examples.japanese: どう{言|い}い{逃|のが}れても{無駄|むだ}だ。
examples.english: No matter how you try to excuse yourself, it's useless.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{上手|じょうず}に{言|い}い{逃|のが}れた。
examples.english: He skillfully talked his way out of it.

notes:
{言|い}い{逃|のが}れる is a compound verb with a negative connotation.

VERB FORMATION:
- {言|い}う (to say) + {逃|のが}れる (to escape)

CONJUGATION:
- Ichidan verb
- Negative: {言|い}い{逃|のが}れない
- Past: {言|い}い{逃|のが}れた
- Te-form: {言|い}い{逃|のが}れて

NOUN FORM:
- {言|い}い{逃|のが}れ (excuse, evasion)

USAGE NOTES:
- Often implies dishonesty or avoiding rightful blame
- Has a negative connotation

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ}をする (to make an excuse)
- {逃|に}げ{口上|こうじょう} (excuse, pretext)
- {弁解|べんかい}する (to justify oneself)
